card.name: Salt-form words in drug names
card.fires_on: The part of a drug's salt form that names the counter-ion, such as sodium, potassium, maleate or bromide. It fires on that part just before the word ends or before the word salt.

modes.label: Split salt names
modes.description: Partway through a salt name split into pieces, such as the OD in sodium, male in maleate, or brom in bromide.

modes.label: Salt counter-ion before salt
modes.description: A whole counter-ion word like potassium or sodium used when comparing salt forms.

card.writes: It seems to add the ending of a salt name or the word salt, though the promoted tokens are not very informative.
card.plain: It marks the salt part of a drug's name, like sodium, potassium or maleate.
